summary: Frontend-only testing of two new features: (1) Admin multi-select employee checkboxes for Service Orders, (2) Supervisor date range text on timesheet cards. Both features pass all tests.

supervisor/index.tsx: getDateRangeText helper correctly shows 'Timesheet do dia DD/MM/YYYY' (single) or 'Timesheet do dia DD/MM/YYYY até DD/MM/YYYY' (multi-day)
Date range text displays in blue (#1a237e) as expected
Expo web app renders correctly in browser
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tested with existing service orders and timesheets
